title: Yield Curve Prediction with Machine Learning - Replication Spec
hypothesis: Direct-yield vs factor-based DNS/DNSS approaches compared under common high-dimensional macro information set; macro augmentation provides incremental power concentrated in slope; time-varying PSO decay parameters improve fit not forecasts; economic vs statistical loss diverge.
data_sources: U.S. zero-coupon Treasury yields from Filipovic-Pelger-Ye 2024, month-end, 1986-05 to 2025-06, at maturities {3,6,12,18,24,36,60,120,240,360} months, slopes 24_120= y(120)-y(24), 24_360, 60_360
FRED-MD monthly U.S. macro panel, 123 series, transformation codes per FRED-MD Table macro_vars_full, publication lag 3 months, lags 4-6 => 369 lagged predictors
sample: Full estimated curve 1986-05 to 2025-06 for fit. Forecasting fixed rolling window: in-sample 1986-05 to 2014-12 re-estimated at each origin; out-of-sample evaluation 2015-01 to 2025-05; validation for RF mtry 2010-01 to 2014-12 =60 targets. Trading backtest same OOS.
method: Step 1: Build target maturities 3,6,12,18,24,36,60,120,240,360 and slopes 24_120,24_360,60_360. Predictor vector x_t = lags 1-6 of yields at all key maturities and lags 4-6 of 123 macro series. Yields/factors enter at t-1, macro at t-4 to enforce 3m publication lag.

Step 3: Direct-yield approach: for each (h,tau) with h in {1,3,6,12} estimate Delta_h y_t(tau)=y_{t+h}-y_t = f_h^{tau}(x_t)+u ; forecast recovered as y_hat=y_t + f_hat(x_t). Implementations: Direct-RF yields-only P=90, Direct-RF-X macro-augmented P=460.

Step 4: Factor-based approach: DNS y_t(tau)=beta0+beta1*(1-exp(-lambda tau))/(lambda tau)+beta2*((1-exp(-lambda tau))/(lambda tau)-exp(-lambda tau)) with lambda=0.0609; DNSS adds beta3 with lambda1=0.0609 lambda2=0.01. Time-varying PSO variant estimates lambda1t,lambda2t + betas via hybrid PSO+L-BFGS-B. Baseline factorization conditional on lambda by OLS; PSO variant uses PSO betas only for lambda then OLS for betas to keep mapping consistent.

Step 5: PSO hyperparameters: swarm 300, max 1000 PSO iterations, stall toll 1e-8, init neighbourhood 10% ring topology increasing radius, w linearly w_start to w_end, c1,c2 fixed, search domain lambda in [1e-9,0.4], beta_j in [-1,1], warm-start one particle at t-1 optimum + anchor lambda1=0.0609 lambda2=0.01 OLS; L-BFGS-B polish top 10 particles max 500 iter ftol 1e-12 gtol 1e-8. Forecast lambda_hat_{t+h|t}=lambda_t random walk. Baseline unconstrained min sum(y-y_hat)^2 s.t. lambda1>=lambda2>=0; ZLB variant adds beta0>=0, beta0+beta1>=0.

Step 6: Factor dynamics: AR(1) direct h-step on each beta level using only beta_{i,t-1}; RF direct h-step on Delta_h beta_{i,t}=beta_{i,t+h}-beta_{i,t} with info set {beta_{t-l}, y_{t-l}, x_{t-j}} l=1..6 j=4..6 then beta_hat=beta_t + Delta_hat. RF=500 trees min leaf 5, m per Table chosen_mtry selected by recursive CV on 2010-01:2014-12 minimizing RMSE over candidates {sqrt(P),P/10,P/6,P/4,P/3,P/2,2P/3} rounded.

Step 7: Forecast evaluation: RMSE_h = sqrt(1/T_h sum(y_{t+h}-y_hat)^2) per maturity/slope/h; Relative RMSE = RMSE_comp / RMSE_RW <1 beats RW. DM test loss differential d_t=L(e1)-L(e2) squared loss DM= d_bar / sqrt(S_d(0)/T) HAC S_d(0) lag = largest <= floor(T^{1/3}) significant at 5% Bartlett bands else 0 per Table hac_sig_lags.
Step 8: Fit evaluation: cross-sectional RMSE_t = sqrt(1/M sum(y_t(tau_m)-y_hat_t(tau_m))^2) averaged over 1986-05:2025-06.

Step 9: Trading backtest: synthetic zero-coupon prices P_t(tau)=exp(-y_t(tau)*tau/12). R_total=(P_{t+h}(tau-h)-P_t(tau))/P_t(tau); R_roll=(P_t(tau-h)-P_t(tau))/P_t(tau); R_curve=R_total-R_roll. Duration: 24,120,360m signal Delta_hat_y = y_hat-y_t w=-Delta_hat/sigma_Delta capped [-1,1]; hold h months closing at tau-h. Slope: 24_120,24_360,60_360 DV01-neutral steepener/flattener if predicted slope > current w_a0=DV01_b/DV01_a w_b0=1 scaled by s=Delta_hat_S / sigma_S. Benchmarks: RW constant long, roll-down w=R_roll/sigma, TSMOM M_t=sum_{j=1}^{12} r_excess_{t-j} w=M/sigma. Volatility scaled sigma from 2y in-sample signals, 1bp one-way TC, evaluation as avg rank/finishes/ann return/roll/curve/Sharpe/hit across 12 tasks=3 targets x4 horizons.
Step 10: Feature importance: impurity MDI I_j sum over splits N_s/N*(Q_s -...) averaged over trees and OOS 2015-01:2025-06 and h, rescaled sum 100 split Macro vs Yields then 8 macro categories.
